violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the chili/cheese dispenser, commercial chili was observed 121f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED THE CHILI. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) chili/cheese dispenser
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. REPAIR OR REPLACE CHILI/CHEESE DISPENSER. ACCORDING TO MANUFACTURE INSTRUCTIONS, DISPENSER SHOULD BE HOT HOLDING THE CHILI AND CHEESE SAUCE AT A MINIMUM OF 140f. DISPENSER IS HOT HOLDING CHILI AT 121f. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed PIC put on gloves before washing hands
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO WASH HANDS BEFORE PUTTING GLOVES ON. WASH HANDS FREQUENTLY, ESPECIALLY AFTER CHANGING TASKS, BEFORE PUTTING GLOVES ON, AFTER RETURNING FROM THE BATHROOM, AFTER TAKING TRASH OUT, ETC.
